title: AMLB: an AutoML Benchmark
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze or measure any aspects related to religion or faith. The benchmark measures the performance of AutoML frameworks on general classification and regression tasks using tabular data.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a subject of the research.
